The GrowthCred field guide

Should you choose AI training or done-for-you automation?

Want to learn it and run it yourself? Take training. Does the work cross systems, need delivery support or need looking after? Talk to us about implementation. Either way, the business decisions stay yours.

By Phila Ngwenya · Reviewed 20 September 2026

When a workshop fits

A workshop suits you if you've got time to practise and you want to understand how it works. Bring one bounded task. Say, drafting a proposal from approved information. You'll learn how to brief it, check it and repeat it.

But you'll still need to keep your business information current. And you'll need to actually use the workflow afterwards. No time for that? Expecting a fully managed service? Then training isn't your answer.

When implementation fits

Implementation fits when information moves between tools, several people approve the work or exceptions need testing. Ask whoever you hire to show it working on your examples. Not just a polished demo.

And agree what happens after handover. Tools change. Permissions change. Messy input breaks things. A delivered project and a managed service are different jobs. Know which one you're buying.

Compare the responsibilities

With training, you invest time learning and practising. With implementation, you invest time briefing, checking and signing off. Either way, someone in your business has to own it. Ask these five questions of either option.

  • Time: who learns, supplies inputs and approves output?
  • Scope: one task, a connected process or ongoing operation?
  • Cost: training fee or project quote, plus tools and support?
  • Ownership: who controls accounts, documents and workflow configuration?
  • Support: what is included, for how long, and how are changes quoted?

Use one task to decide

Write down one task you do every week. Its inputs. What a good output looks like. How long it takes now. Can you practise it safely in a browser? Then the workshop might be your first step. Does it need several integrations and operational checks? Ask us for a scope assessment.

The workshop and done-for-you work are separate offers. You can talk to us about fit without signing up for anything later. Ask us to confirm availability, scope and every cost before you choose.
